metadata.status: EXPLORATORY ESTIMATE; BALANCE PROPOSAL NOT APPROVED
metadata.combo_scoring: excluded from card cost; separate random-order activation frequency is measured, but expected board swing and participant-level EFP are not calibrated
metadata.dominant_faction: choose any faction tied for the highest number of units; matching leader sampled uniformly from that faction

without_equipped_relic.scenario: 12 cards + faction-compatible leader load; no equipped relic
without_equipped_relic.leader_assumption: uniform random among leaders belonging to a faction tied for the highest unit count in the sampled deck

with_equipped_relic.scenario: 12 cards + faction-compatible leader load + equipped relic
with_equipped_relic.equipped_relic_assumption: uniform random among six relics; that same relic is excluded from the 12 deck slots
with_equipped_relic.leader_assumption: uniform random among leaders belonging to a faction tied for the highest unit count in the sampled deck

limitations: Random deck-list cost sampling, not matches, combat outcomes, or win-rate simulation.
EFP values for card effects and leaders remain subjective provisional estimates.
Combos are excluded from card cost. A separate random-order report measures trigger frequency, but not expected score swing or competitive value; no combo EFP is assigned.
The model uniformly samples cards and leader choices; actual ownership, rarity/power exemplars, player choice and faction-specific strategy are not modeled.
Nine unresolved card models are excluded, so this is not a complete 137-model sample.
The six suspected faction assignments in the Forgotten expansion remain uncorrected in this baseline; faction distribution will change after their approved reassignment.
The equipped relic is modeled as an extra cost and excluded from the 12 deck slots, matching the current backend validation rule.
This model does not validate whether a 32-point cap is competitively fair.
interpretation: Use only to compare budget sensitivity under stated assumptions; do not approve or implement a budget based on this sample alone.
